additional_info.subject: RE: ID0451456-DC/Si-UC/-[Y2 311416907/95] logs check CRM:02888000268
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena Carusone,
Thank you for your message. I have checked the charger (Y2 / S1 313483122003) in SCB, and I can confirm that it is currently online and does not have any active error flags, as shown in the attached screenshot. To better understand and resolve the issue, could you please provide more details about the problem?
Specifically: In the first case, you mentioned the recharge was automatically interrupted. Could you clarify if there was any error message displayed on the charger? At which time have that problem occurred?
In the subsequent cases, the recharge was authorized but resulted in a 0 kWh session? Was there any indication on the vehicle or charger about why the charging session?
Has the issue occurred with different vehicles or always with the same one?
With this information, we will be able to investigate further and provide more details about the problem.
Thank you very much for your cooperation and trust. We remain at your disposal for any further assistance.
With best regards,
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
